events.title: Tripfoundation On Fire
events.description:
🔥 TRIPFOUNDATION ON FIRE – THE ULTIMATE FIRE EVENT OF THE YEAR! 🔥

This is more than just a show – it’s a night where fire meets the art! Once a year, we gather to dive into a world of flames and breathtaking performances. The real fire theater!

WHAT TO EXPECT:

🎶 18:00 – GATES OPEN Sunset vibes from our DJ, and the first sparks of magic. Come early to join our fire workshops!

⚡ BLAZING FIRE BATTLES The best of the best will face off in an epic showdown. The crowd decides the winner!

📸 FIRE PHOTOSHOOT Get a stunning shot in a fiery look with a professional photographer during the break after the fire battles!

🔥 20:00 – THE GRAND FIRE SHOW A breathtaking spectacle featuring top fire artists, mind-blowing effects, and an unforgettable performance.

💃 FIRE JAM WITH A SPECIAL DJ SET Feel the rhythm, let loose, and become part of the fire flow!

🚀 Only once a year – don’t miss it!

📍 Tripfoundation goo.su/HESRTD0 💰 Entry: Before 20:00 – 500 INR | From 20:00 – 1000 INR | After 22:00 – 1500 INR
🔗 More info: @tripfoundation | @goaonfire

🔥 TRIPFOUNDATION ON FIRE – ГЛАВНОЕ ОГНЕННОЕ СОБЫТИЕ ГОДА! 🔥  

Это не просто шоу – это ночь, когда пламя становится искусством! Один раз в году мы собираемся, чтобы погрузиться в мир огня: завораживающее зрелище, живая энергия и атмосфера, от которой захватывает дух. Как театр, но горячее!  

ЧТО ВАС ЖДЕТ:  

🎶 18:00 – ОТКРЫТИЕ ДВЕРЕЙ В ОГНЕННУЮ СТИХИЮ  
Закат, атмосферный диджей-сет и первые искры волшебства. Приходи пораньше – пока играет музыка, у тебя есть шанс погрузиться в мир огня на мастерклассах:  

🔥 Веера – грация, стиль и выразительность с Марией Русиновой  
🔥 Пои – динамика, ритм и флоу с Игорем Поливодой  

⚡ ЖАРКИЕ БАТТЛЫ  
Лучшие из лучших сойдутся в огненном поединке. Жаркое противостояние, эффектные трюки, максимальный драйв и ценный приз для победителя! Это зрелище, от которого невозможно оторваться, а победителя выбирают зрители!

📸 ФОТОСЕССИЯ С ОГОНЬКОМ  
Уникальная возможность примерить на себя огненный образ и запечатлеть этот момент навсегда! Каждый желающий сможет сфотографироваться во время нашей огненной фотопаузы с профессиональным фотографом. Время работы ограничено!  

🔥 20:00 – ГРАНДИОЗНОЕ ОГНЕННОЕ ШОУ  
Это больше, чем шоу – это настоящая огненная постановка, наполненная движением, эмоциями и искусством. Лучшие артисты, спецэффекты и завораживающий перформанс только для #OnFire. Этот момент захочется проживать снова и снова!  

💃 ФАЕР-ДЖЕМ ПОД СПЕЦИАЛЬНЫЙ ДИДЖЕЙ-СЕТ  
Этот момент – твой! Танцы, поток энергии и атмосфера, которую не передать словами.  

🚀 Такое происходит только раз в году. Ты не захочешь это пропустить!

events.title: Marrakesh Meets Tulum
events.description:
Marrakesh Meets Tulum – A Night of Rhythm, Ritual & Revelry
Date: Saturday, 14th June 2025 | Venue: Fiturr, Anjuna, Goa | Time: 7 PM onwards

Step into a world where two vibrant cultures collide in the most magical way. Marrakesh Meets Tulum is not just an event — it’s an immersive experience that blends the mysticism of Moroccan souks with the bohemian spirit of Tulum’s vibes. From ornate  décor and ambient lighting to tropical undertones and jungle beats, this one-of-a-kind evening at Fiturr, Anjuna will awaken all your senses. Imagine sipping cocktails , the air thick with incense and rhythm, while belly dancers and musicians transport you across continents — all without leaving Goa.

Headlining the night is Ohara, a genre-bending live act known for their textured, organic soundscapes.

Martin, a seasoned music producer and percussionist, builds a powerful electronic foundation using Ableton, Elektron, and Roland synths — his work has even graced runways at Lakmé Fashion Week.

Nevin, a gifted multi-instrumentalist, adds warmth with soulful guitar, expressive keys, and evocative vocals, creating an East-meets-West harmony that’s both hypnotic and deeply moving.

The experience is heightened by a live belly dance performance by @kate_ingoa, dramatic stilt performers, and a curated space designed to echo Marrakesh’s colors and Tulum’s free-spirited vibe. It’s a celebration of global fusion — in sound, style, and soul.

events.title: Pande Monium
events.description:
Goa's vibrant music scene traces its roots to the 1960s, when hippies flocked to its shores seeking freedom and a new kind of music: psychedelic rock. This evolved into the mesmerizing beats of psy trance. The documentary *The Last Hippie Standing* captures this era of free, communal beach parties.

We're organizing a free party to honor this legacy of community, inclusivity, and freedom. Let's celebrate the spirit of those early days, where music was shared freely under the moonlit sky.

We thank all the artists, dancers, fire performers, bartenders, and visual artists who make this night possible. Together, they are the heartbeat of this movement.

Let's protect our unique nightlife, keeping it free, vibrant, and open for all.

Young Marco's sonic journey spans far and wide, exploring diverse genres of club music before shaping his own trance-inducing sound. His high-energy psychedelic house and techno sets captivate crowds worldwide, lifting them into states of ecstasy.

As the mastermind behind Safe Trip Records, Marco champions up-and-coming talent and releases sought-after compilations like "Welcome To Paradise" and "Planet Love." With two studio albums and a plethora of EPs and remixes under his belt, his uplifting sound resonates deeply.

Collaborating with artists such as Robyn and Metronomy, Marco infuses tracks with his signature flair. As part of Gaussian Curve, alongside Gigi Masin and Jonny Nash, he contributes to the ambient revival with albums like "Clouds" and "The Distance."

In 2022, Marco expanded his repertoire by producing his first feature-length film score for "Met Mes." The following year, his crossover hit "What You Say?"

✨ Journey Within: Estatic Dance with DJ Freeda ✨

Embrace the New Year with a Dance of Liberation.

🌿 Join us for the first Ecstatic Dance of 2025 as we journey inward with the mesmerizing sounds of DJ Freeda.

Freeda is a Siberian DJ renowned for her vibrant energy and unique blend of shamanic rhythms and electronic music. Having toured globally and co-founded Georgia's leading conscious dance community, Harmony, she delivers captivating sets that connect mind, body, and spirit. 

Her journey has taken her across the globe, from Koh Phangan and Bali to Tbilisi (Georgia) and Yerevan (Armenia), where she immersed herself in Ecstatic Dance practices, both as a dancer and performer.

Her sets are a captivating blend of shamanic rhythms and diverse musical genres, weaving together ethnic melodies with electronic beats, organic house, bass, trance, breakbeat, and more.

HMG Official TEAMS

J Lawrence Pro Audio & Akkadian Project (Sound and Production) Isaikadelic (Decor) Day Dreamer (VJ)  ProDigies (Photography & Video Production)

events.title: Cornucopia V: Jay Carder

Cornucopia V : Jay Carder (UK), Luke x Animism & Moder8

This one's special! The official opening of the Sunset Deck at Dancing Goats in association with Wavlngth.

Jay Carder fuses UK techno with bass, breaks and 4/4. Laden with percussion, her selections are a concoction of heavy leftfield sonics and lighter psychedelic sounds. Having played at parties in the underground dance community for ~8 years alongside the likes of Modeselektor, Artwork, The Chemical Brothers, her unique connection to the dance floor is key to her energy and ethos.

Goa Music Lab is the musical mastermind of Luke and Animism as they return to stage playing their signature style of Analog Electronica with drum machines and loopers. 

Moder8 is the resident Dancing Goats DJ belting out some liquid and minimal techno tunes for the first sundowner on the Sunset Deck!

Shiny Go hailing outta Russia is a professional VJ onboard the Cornucopia express to enhance the visual experience of the true Goan underground.

events.description:
We are extremely excited to announce our brand new Sunday Sundowner residency and collaboration with Iziki Global every sunday at the stunning beachfront property, Elrow in Calangute, Goa. We will be showcasing beautiful deep melodic afro grooves and bringing some of Africa's best musicians to the beaches of Goa.

Afro house is a genre of electronic dance music that originated in Africa, particularly in South Africa. It blends elements of traditional african music, such as african percussion and vocals, with electronic beats and production techniques. Afro house is known for its infectious rhythms, vibrant melodies, and energetic grooves.

We kick off the fourth edition this Sunday, 16th of July. All our sets will be infused with live elements. The event starts at 4 PM and continues till late. Tickets are available on Insider.

events.title: Full Spectrum 70.0
events.description:
Monday Night Dancefloor Warriors 
FULL SPECTRUM 70.0: A Cosmic Journey Through Sound
Get ready for an extraordinary night of electric  vibrations morphing tru Multi Genres as Full Spectrum 70.0 takes over House of Chapora on Monday, November 24th from 8 PM onwards. 
This immersive musical experience brings together an international lineup of visionary artists ready to transport you through dimensions of sound and color.
THE LINEUP
MYSAMEDUZA (Russia) headlines the evening, bringing the distinctive full-on psytrance energy that has made them a favorite in the global scene. Known for powerful, driving basslines and euphoric melodies, Mysameduza's sets are a masterclass in peak-time psychedelic storytelling.
BRIANOID (India) joins the cosmic caravan with his signature blend of progressive and psychedelic sounds. His intricate sound design and atmospheric journeys have established him as one of India's most innovative producers.
MAGIC HIDDEN (Iran) adds Middle Eastern mysticism to the mix, weaving hypnotic patterns and ancient vibes into modern psytrance frameworks that captivate dance floors worldwide.
JOD (India) represents the next generation of Indian psytrance, delivering fresh perspectives and boundary-pushing productions that honor tradition while embracing innovation.
BEAT FREQUENCY (India) rounds out the international roster, bringing high-energy grooves and festival-tested tracks guaranteed to keep the vibe ascending throughout the night.
THE VENUE
House of Chapora in Anjuna-Caisua provides the perfect backdrop for this sonic odyssey. Located in the heart of Goa's legendary party belt, this venue combines stunning natural beauty with world-class sound systems and visuals.
SUPPORTED BY
HOC Resident DJs will warm up and support the international headliners, ensuring seamless musical flow from sunset to sunrise.
Presented by:  Digital Distortion Records, Air Snare Records.

events.title: Candle Light YIN Yoga
events.description:
Candle Light Yin Yoga (very slow yoga)

Experience slow yoga with beauty of night alongwith candle lights and healing musical beats

What is yin yoga?
While “yang” yoga focuses on your muscles, yin yoga targets your deep connective tissues, like your fascia, ligaments, joints, and bones. It’s slower and more meditative, giving you space to turn inward and tune into both your mind and the physical sensations of your body. Because you’re holding poses for a longer period of time than you would in other traditional types of yoga, yin yoga helps you stretch and lengthen those rarely-used tissues while also teaching you how to breathe through discomfort and sit with your thoughts.

Note:
*Reach 5 minutes in advance to avoid delay and settle yourself.
*Bring a blindfold or something to cover your eyes for deeper experience
*Wear comfortable loose clothes in which you can move easily 
*Strictly keep your mobile on complete silence
*Please bring your mat/ sheet for hygiene, we also have mats 🙏🏼

events.title: Susmit Sen Trio
events.description:
Susmit Sen, founder of India's premier fusion rock band, Indian Ocean, has an illustrious music career spanning 30 years. When he founded Indian Ocean in 1990, there was no pan-Indian band writing original music. Over the next few years, Indian Ocean's musical sensibility was led by Sen's compositions and unique guitar playing inspired by Indian classical and folk.  What followed was a sensation. Indian Ocean toured more than twenty countries, produced six albums over the next two decades and played a kind of music never heard before: an Indian expression using mostly Western instruments, anchored by Susmit's self-taught guitar.

 

By the time he came out with his first solo album in collaboration with some of the most renowned musicians in India (Depths of the Ocean, 2011), and then parted ways with Indian Ocean, Susmit had inspired a few generations. 

He continues to innovate, working with his current band, Susmit Sen Chronicles, as well as a variety of other musicians and artists
